notes.subject: בצלעי
notes.rationale: a kɔrɔ ko 'n ka kenɛ-ŋgirili' (limping) — YLT 'in my halting'; KJV/ASV fɔla ko 'n ka gɛlɛya waati'

notes.subject: נכים
notes.rationale: nɛkɛw = smiters/koɲumabagaw (figurative: kuma-jugutigiw, traducers) — KJV 'the abjects'

notes.subject: ולא דמו
notes.rationale: 'u tun ma a bila' (they ceased not, KJV) ni 'u tun ma kuma dogo' (they were not silent, jalaki ma jaabi) yɛlɛma bɛ yen minnu cɛ

notes.subject: ונאספו נאספו
notes.rationale: kumaw fila-fila kelen-kelen (infinitive-like repetition) min bɛ lajɛli caya — a mara Bamanankan na ni 'lakelena' kelen ye, a kumara dɔlen don

translation: Nka ni n tun bɛ nɔgɛya la, u dondiyera ani u lakelena; nɛkɛw lakelena n kan, ⟨mɔgɔw⟩ minnu ma n dɔn; u ye n ɲagami, u tun ma a bila.

tokens.gloss: ni n tun bɛ nɔgɛya la
